set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2] disable.explanation: Disable a specific unit of an interface

parameters.name: unit number
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface to be disabled

set interfaces [interface].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface]` in Junos configures a specific network interface, allowing you to define its properties and settings.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured.

unit [unit] family [family] port-mode [m.explanation: Configures the port mode for a specified interface unit family in Ethernet switching mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface configuration.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: The port mode to be set for the interface.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

unit [parameter2] vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: unit

parameters.name: vlan-id
